mapper.insert: INSERT INTO eval_gate (gate_id, name, safety_dims, score_thresholds, trials, enabled, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{gateId}, #{name}, #{safetyDims}, #{scoreThresholds}, #{trials}, #{enabled}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: SELECT id, gate_id, name, safety_dims, score_thresholds, trials, enabled, create_time, update_time FROM eval_gate WHERE gate_id = #{gateId}
SELECT id, gate_id, name, safety_dims, score_thresholds, trials, enabled, create_time, update_time FROM eval_gate WHERE name = #{name}
SELECT id, gate_id, name, safety_dims, score_thresholds, trials, enabled, create_time, update_time FROM eval_gate ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
